iti36:1.1: 9 vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatāti me sutaṃ
iti36:2.1: nayidaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ vussati janakuhanatthaṃ na janalapanatthaṃ na lābhasakkārasilokānisaṃsatthaṃ na iti maṃ jano jānātūti
iti36:2.2: atha kho idaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ vussati abhiññatthañceva pariññatthañcāti.
iti36:5.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
